scope: Own synchronous imported functions whose arguments and result are primitive VerifiedIR values. Every import is derived from a freshly revalidated module and interface context. Exact canonical plan bytes must be independently pinned by the consumer.

representation.smallMachineIntegers: canonical integer number in exact signed/unsigned range, excluding negative zero
representation.wideMachineIntegers: bigint in exact range; word-sized types require explicit 32/64-bit target
representation.float: IEEE binary64 number, preserving signed zero and allowing NaN/infinities
representation.float32: number exactly representable in binary32, including signed zero, NaN and infinities

rules: A module with invalid bodies, unresolved/mismatched interfaces, unsupported target or denied capabilities cannot produce a plan.
The host independently checks canonical bytes, identity, exact schema, scalar types, unique local names and capability grants before observing providers.
Bindings snapshot explicit own data-property host functions; accessors are rejected. No module path, network URL or checker code is loaded from a plan.
Each call checks exact arity and argument values before invocation, then result values before release. There is no implicit coercion or numeric wrapping.
Frozen null-prototype bindings preserve original selected functions across namespace mutation. Host exceptions propagate as failures; promises fail scalar result checking.
Plan size/depth/node/import/arity limits and per-call string/integer limits fail closed. Host function CPU, allocations and effects are not bounded by this adapter.

evidence.actualTargetClient: PSC-emitted JavaScript linked to the real adapter in the VM-module integration fixture
evidence.portable: PSC1 source check plus structural rules; broad/global assurance pending
evidence.productionBinding: checked build graph records exact VerifiedIR -> ABI plan pass, archives policy/plan, EvidenceEnvelope references both, and offline archive replay recomputes the relation

unsupported: Wasm Component canonical ABI and native Rust/C ABIs
authority: Adapter conformance to primitive representation does not prove foreign behavior, confine capabilities, validate host Proxy behavior, establish CheckedCore authority, promote direct JS or close the global external-ABI gap.
remaining: other value profiles and target ABIs
